title: Clinician Use of Incretin-Based Therapies in Type 2 Diabetes
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 10 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary clinical role?
How many years have you been in clinical practice?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: Which of the following GLP-1 or dual-incretin therapies do you currently prescribe for type 2 diabetes?
Which one of these therapies do you prescribe most often for type 2 diabetes?
How satisfied are you with {Q2} for your type 2 diabetes patients?

piping.note: Insert the therapy selected at Q2 into the question text.

questions.text: You prescribe three or more incretin-based therapies. What is the main factor that determines which one a new patient starts on?

options.label: Patient preference for device or administration

questions.text: What is the single biggest barrier to starting patients on an incretin-based therapy?
What percentage of your type 2 diabetes patients are currently on any incretin-based therapy?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100.

questions.text: How likely are you to recommend incretin-based therapy to a colleague managing type 2 diabetes?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
